setup.description: Create every missing file in secrets/ the compose files mount, and .env; prints the admin password and API key once; on an AppArmor host, installs the sandbox's AppArmor profile through sudo (--only, --force: see secrets/README.md)

doctor.command: deno run --deny-ffi "--allow-read=.,$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q chromium:read || echo .)" --allow-write=secrets "--allow-env=TTK_*,HOME,USERPROFILE,LOCALAPPDATA,PROGRAMFILES,PROGRAMFILES(X86),PATH,OTEL_DENO,OTEL_DENO_VSOCK,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT" packages/cli/mod.ts doctor

seed.description: Copy the providers file and browser secrets into data/ttk.db (TTK_DATA_DIR=data); --force replaces

dev.description: The HTTP gateway with file watching, loopback network and the host Chromium
dev.command: deno run --no-prompt --deny-ffi --allow-env=TTK_OTEL_ENDPOINTS,OTEL_DENO,OTEL_DENO_VSOCK,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT packages/cli/gate.ts && TTK_BROWSER_PATH="$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --pin --serve || echo)" deno run --watch --no-prompt --deny-ffi --allow-net=127.0.0.1 "--allow-read=.,$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --write),$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --grant --serve || echo ttk-tier/no-chromium-resolved)" "--allow-write=$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --write),data" "--allow-run=$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --grant --serve || echo ttk-tier/no-chromium-resolved),$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --serve-ffmpeg || echo ttk-tier/no-ffmpeg-resolved)" --allow-env=TTK_*,HOME,USERPROFILE,LOCALAPPDATA,PROGRAMFILES,PATH,OTEL_DENO,OTEL_DENO_VSOCK,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT packages/cli/mod.ts serve

stdio.description: MCP over stdio for a local client, with dev's grants
stdio.command: TTK_BROWSER_PATH="$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --pin --serve || echo)" deno run --no-prompt --deny-ffi --allow-net=127.0.0.1 "--allow-read=.,$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --write),$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --grant --serve || echo ttk-tier/no-chromium-resolved)" "--allow-write=$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --write),data" "--allow-run=$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --grant --serve || echo ttk-tier/no-chromium-resolved),$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --serve-ffmpeg || echo ttk-tier/no-ffmpeg-resolved)" --allow-env=TTK_*,HOME,USERPROFILE,LOCALAPPDATA,PROGRAMFILES,PATH,OTEL_DENO,OTEL_DENO_VSOCK,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT packages/cli/mod.ts stdio

serve:cluster.description: The HTTP gateway with --unstable-kv, for TTK_CLUSTER_KV
serve:cluster.command: TTK_BROWSER_PATH="$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --pin --serve || echo)" deno run --no-prompt --deny-ffi --unstable-kv --allow-net=127.0.0.1,localhost "--allow-read=.,$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --write),$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --grant --serve || echo ttk-tier/no-chromium-resolved)" "--allow-write=$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --write),data" "--allow-run=$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q resolve:chromium --grant --serve || echo ttk-tier/no-chromium-resolved),$(OTEL_DENO=false deno task -q tier:paths --serve-ffmpeg || echo ttk-tier/no-ffmpeg-resolved)" --allow-env=TTK_*,HOME,USERPROFILE,LOCALAPPDATA,PROGRAMFILES,PATH,OTEL_DENO,OTEL_DENO_VSOCK,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT packages/cli/mod.ts serve

acp.description: Agent Client Protocol over stdio, relayed to the ACP agent runner

build:web.description: Bundle the web app and the MCP Apps embeds into packages/web/dist
build:web.command: rm -rf packages/web/dist && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --code-splitting --outdir packages/web/dist packages/web/src/app.ts && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir packages/web/dist packages/web/src/styles/app.css && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir packages/web/dist/screens packages/web/src/styles/screens/tools.css packages/web/src/styles/screens/resources.css packages/web/src/styles/screens/agents.css packages/web/src/styles/screens/users.css packages/web/src/styles/screens/system.css && deno run --allow-read=packages/web --allow-write=packages/web/dist scripts/build_icons.ts && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir packages/web/dist/embed-src packages/web/src/embed_live.ts && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir packages/web/dist/embed-src packages/web/src/embed_a2ui.ts && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir packages/web/dist/embed-src packages/web/src/embed_terminal.ts && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir packages/web/dist/embed-src packages/web/src/styles/embed.css && deno run --allow-read=packages/web --allow-write=packages/web/dist scripts/build_embed.ts

compile.description: Single binary in dist/ with baked permissions (run build:web first)

build:image.description: Build the bundled image tykotech-mcp:0.2.0 (docker compose build builds the whole stack)

ok.description: Pre-commit gate: fmt:check, lint, check, gate:tasks, gate:lock, test:unit
ok.command: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task gate:tasks && deno task gate:lock && deno task test:unit

gate:tasks.description: Lint this task table: exact permissions, --deny-ffi first, the OTEL and provider-key rules

test:unit.description: Unit tier: every package and tests/unit (bare read/write: Deno.symlink refuses path-scoped grants)
test:unit.command: deno test --unstable-kv --parallel --allow-net=127.0.0.1,localhost --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env=TTK_*,BUA_*,BROWSER_USE_*,TIMEOUT_*,ANTHROPIC_API_KEY packages/bus/ packages/cdp/ packages/browser/ packages/wire/ packages/sandbox/ packages/agents/ packages/mcp/ packages/gateway/ packages/web/ packages/cli/ tests/unit/ tests/agents/a2a_test.ts tests/agents/runtime_test.ts

test:browser.description: Real-browser tier (tests/e2e); resolves Chromium, ffmpeg and a model endpoint
test:browser.command: BUA_TEST_CHROMIUM="$(deno task -q resolve:chromium --pin || echo)" TTK_FFMPEG="$(deno task -q tier:paths --ffmpeg-pin || echo)" TTK_MODEL_CONFIG="$(deno task -q tier:paths --model-pin || echo)" deno test --unstable-kv "--allow-net=$(deno task -q tier:paths --net || echo 127.0.0.1,localhost)" "--allow-run=$(deno task -q resolve:chromium --grant || echo ttk-tier/no-chromium-resolved),$(deno task -q tier:paths --ffmpeg)" "--allow-read=$(deno task -q tier:paths --read)" "--allow-write=$(deno task -q tier:paths --write)" --allow-env=TTK_*,BUA_*,BROWSER_USE_*,TIMEOUT_*,ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,HOME,USERPROFILE,LOCALAPPDATA,PROGRAMFILES,PATH,TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP tests/e2e/

test:stdio.description: stdio tier: the CLI over pipes

test:compile.description: Compile the binary for this host and run it

test:container.description: Verify the bundled image (default tykotech-mcp:0.2.0; another: deno task test:container <tag>)

test:container:slim.description: Verify the slim image (default tykotech-mcp:slim; another: deno task test:container:slim <tag>)

test:sandbox.description: Sandbox tier: real bubblewrap cages in the sandbox image
test:sandbox.command: deno run --deny-ffi "--allow-run=$(deno task -q resolve:docker || echo ttk-tier/no-docker-resolved)" --allow-read=. --allow-write=tests/.scratch --allow-net=127.0.0.1,localhost --allow-env=TTK_*,PATH tests/sandbox/verify_sandbox.ts

test:compose.description: Compose proof of the default stack, from images built under --tag <t>
test:compose.command: deno run --deny-ffi "--allow-run=$(deno task -q resolve:docker || echo ttk-tier/no-docker-resolved)" --allow-read=. --allow-write=tests/.scratch --allow-net=127.0.0.1,localhost --allow-env=TTK_*,PATH tests/sandbox/verify_compose.ts

test:agents.description: Agents tier: ACP, bridge, peers and the model loop

test:agents:runner.description: The ACP runner image with a fixture agent
test:agents:runner.command: deno run --deny-ffi "--allow-run=$(deno task -q resolve:docker || echo ttk-tier/no-docker-resolved)" --allow-read=. --allow-write=tests/.scratch --allow-net=127.0.0.1,localhost --allow-env=TTK_*,PATH tests/agents/verify_runner.ts

test:agents:compose.description: Compose proof of the agents overlay, from images built under --tag <t>
test:agents:compose.command: deno run --deny-ffi "--allow-run=$(deno task -q resolve:docker || echo ttk-tier/no-docker-resolved)" --allow-read=. --allow-write=tests/.scratch --allow-net=127.0.0.1,localhost --allow-env=TTK_*,PATH tests/agents/verify_compose.ts

cov.description: Coverage gate: unit, agents and browser tiers merged; 80% lines over packages/mcp and packages/gateway
cov.command: deno task cov:unit && deno task cov:agents && deno task cov:browser && deno run -A scripts/coverage.ts coverage/unit coverage/agents coverage/browser

resolve:chromium.description: Helper: the Chromium the tasks and tiers grant and launch
resolve:chromium.command: deno run "--allow-read=$(deno task -q chromium:read || echo .)" "--allow-env=BUA_TEST_CHROMIUM,BUA_BROWSER_PATH,BROWSER_USE_BROWSER_PATH,TTK_BROWSER_PATH,LOCALAPPDATA,PROGRAMFILES,PROGRAMFILES(X86),USERPROFILE,HOME,PATH" scripts/resolve_chromium.ts

chromium:read.description: Helper: the read grant resolve:chromium needs

tier:paths.description: Helper: temp, ffmpeg and model-endpoint grants for the tasks and tiers

resolve:docker.description: Helper: the docker binary the container tiers run
